🔗 Connect to Google Sheets

This app syncs live with your Google Sheet. Follow these 4 steps once, then it works automatically every time.

Step 1 — Import your Excel into Google Sheets
Go to sheets.google.com → File → Import → upload your Villas_Progress_Sheet.xlsx
Step 2 — Open Apps Script
In your Google Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script → delete all existing code → paste the code from the GoogleAppsScript_VillaTracker.js file you downloaded → click 💾 Save
Step 3 — Deploy as Web App
Click Deploy → New deployment → Type: Web app → Execute as: Me → Who has access: Anyone → click Deploy → copy the Web App URL
Step 4 — Paste URL below and connect
